args.summary: The latest deployment of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. Rollback was successful; service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate down to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
**Summary of actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Found that v2.3.1 (the latest deploy of checkout-api) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Confirmed the service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.
